source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. Boss battle: intense and dramatic, high stakes, a powerful foe; urgency and heroic defiance. Tempo 150 BPM, 4/4 time, key of C minor. Instrumentation: trumpet and brass melody over a pounding riff, timpani, driving drums, fast string ostinato, electric bass, organ accents. Form: short dramatic intro, riff, brass melody, bridge, melody again. Duration: 90 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
